description: Statutory edges: the clerical-error branch rather than the deception branch; and the art. 55A.006 notwithstanding-art.-55A.001 edge, where the applicant was NEVER ARRESTED at all and their identifiers simply ended up in an arrest record. Arrest facts the applicant cannot know are left empty for the prosecutor to supplement under art. 55A.256(c) rather than guessed. The fee-waiver branch brings in the Rule 145 dependency.
syntheticDataNote: All values are obviously synthetic and are never drawn from any evidence file. Names are SAMPLE/EXAMPLE strings, the county is EXAMPLE, addresses are 000-prefixed, and every date is a round synthetic value. Dates here are participant screening answers, not sourced facts; no date in this fixture is asserted by any source.

protectedFieldsNote: Article 55A.253(a) requires the petition to carry sex, race, date of birth, driver's licence number, social security number and the address at the time of arrest, and the TRN must appear on the order under art. 55A.301. All of them are blank here and are never prefilled by any pipeline stage. How the largest counties handle sensitive data in a public civil expunction filing is a recorded release blocker; the participant supplies these by hand.
outsidePartyFieldsNote: Blank and never prefilled. The matter is a new civil action and receives a NEW cause number on filing, so no cause number can exist beforehand. The court sets the hearing not earlier than the 30th day after filing and the clerk serves under art. 55A.254; the participant does not serve. No position of the attorney representing the state, no service completion and no hearing outcome is ever stated.
attachments: Authenticated fingerprint records from a DPS FAST location (participant obtains and submits)
boundaryUnderTest: Ground edge: clerical error rather than another person's deception. Article 55A.006 reaches both; the two branches have different factual accounts and the same procedure.

Article 55A.001 edge: art. 55A.006 operates NOTWITHSTANDING the arrest requirement, so the applicant need not have been arrested at all. This fixture takes that branch and leaves every arrest fact empty.
Article 55A.256(c) edge: arrest information the applicant does not know is left empty for the prosecutor to supplement. It is never guessed and never filled by any pipeline stage.
Hearing edge: none. Article 55A.256(d) has the court enter a final order without a hearing, so the 30-day hearing window that governs the sibling art. 55A.251 tracks does not exist here.
Consent edge: consentGiven = no. Consent to another person's use of the applicant's identifying information takes the case outside the ground entirely.
